channel.description: Compare how India's media, left, centre and right, covers each story, side by side.

item.title: Dozens of students fall ill and hospitalised in Kolkata school
item.description: At least 31 students from a government school in Kolkata fell ill and were hospitalised on Tuesday. Seven more students from Park Institution for Girls were also hospitalised, leading to the closure of their hostel. In a separate incident… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 2 (n=7).

item.title: Hunter Biden Discusses Father Joe Biden's Cancer and Pain
item.description: Hunter Biden has stated that his father, former U.S. President Joe Biden, has prostate cancer that has spread to his bones and is causing him significant pain. This information was revealed by Hunter Biden in May 2025, four months after… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 7 · Right 0 (n=8).

item.title: Louisiana Reports Vibrio Vulnificus Cases and Deaths
item.description: Louisiana has reported nine cases of Vibrio vulnificus infections, a type of "flesh-eating bacteria," resulting in five deaths. Health officials stated that Vibrio infections can lead to gastrointestinal illness, wound infections, and… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0 (n=3).

item.title: BHU surgeons reconstruct jaw using leg bone after tumour removal
item.description: A surgical team at Banaras Hindu University (BHU) successfully removed a massive tumour and reconstructed a patient's jaw. The reconstruction utilized a fibula bone from the patient's leg. The procedure aimed to restore the patient's… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0 (n=2).

item.title: Hepatitis A Outbreak in Haryana Village Affects Over 100
item.description: An outbreak of Hepatitis A has affected over 100 people in a village in Haryana. The illness is allegedly linked to contamination of the drinking water supply. Local health authorities are reportedly investigating the situation. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0 (n=2).

item.title: Actress Avika Gor Hospitalised With Dengue
item.description: Actress Avika Gor has been hospitalised after testing positive for dengue. Her husband, Milind, shared an update on her health. Gor reportedly worked through a high fever before being admitted to the hospital. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 1 (n=4).

item.title: Nipah Survivor Discharged After Full Recovery
item.description: A survivor of the Nipah virus has been discharged from a hospital in Kerala after two months of intensive care. The individual has made a full recovery from the infection. This marks a positive outcome for the patient who battled the virus. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0 (n=2).

item.description: Over a period of more than four years, Punjab dispensed 56 crore pills intended for the treatment of drug addiction. item.description: Experts have stated that breastfeeding within the first hour of a baby's birth significantly improves both maternal and child health. This practice is identified as a crucial public health priority. The coverage suggests that current… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1 (n=2).

item.description: The Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has become the fastest-growing on record, with over 1,700 deaths reported. item.description: Gujarat has reported 22 child deaths attributed to the Chandipura virus during the monsoon season.
